data.name: Chess Go
data.detailed_description:
Why Are 3D Hyper Board Games So Cool?

Space Battle:
A flat board only has "length" and "width," but a 3D board adds "height"! With attacking, defending, and surrounding, the number of possible strategies multiplies, challenging your brain to think even faster!

Classic Games, New Experiences:
Familiar games, brand-new excitement! In 3D Chess, your "Chariot" might "fly" through the air to checkmate the opponent. In 3D Go, you might surround territory on a "mountain." Just thinking about it is thrilling!

Game Varieties:

  • Rhombic Dodecahedron Go

  • Bidirectional chess

  • Bidirectional Chinese Chess

  • 3D Go

  • 3D Gomoku

  • 3D Reversi （3D Othello）

  • 4-Player 3D Chess

  • 4-Player 3D Chinese Chess

  • Multi-Layer Chinese Chess

  • Borderless Go

A bidirectional combat chess variant.

Traditional chess only allows attacks against enemy pieces in front, resulting in rigid tactics. This design attempts to create a bidirectional combat chess variant, transforming the traditional one‑way combat model into a two‑way model. In this bidirectional combat chess variant, pieces may cross over to the adjacent board at both the front and rear dividing lines to continue placing their moves, with no restrictions on front or rear edges. The basic rules remain the same as those of traditional chess.

A transparent three‑dimensional chess set designed for four‑player combat.

The rules remain compatible with traditional chess while extending the game with three‑dimensional logic, and it supports both team‑play and free‑for‑all modes. Any player may, following standard chess movement rules, move their pieces onto the boards of the other three players.

data.short_description: In the world of games, every wonder is possible—but for the truly extraordinary, look no further than Hyper Board Games! Imagine this: pieces don’t just move forward, backward, left, or right—they also move up and down, "flying" through the air and "jumping" across multi-level boards!
